title: Malmstrom AFB disc wobbling on edge

tellings.quote: May not Air Force Base, home of nuclear weapons uh uh uh missiles. A border patrol officer sees a metallic disc, direct quote, wobbling on its edge, 30 feet wide, 100 feet away.

plain: At Malmstrom Air Force Base, home to nuclear missiles, a border patrol officer saw a metallic disc, "wobbling on its edge," in his own quoted words, about 30 feet wide and 100 feet away. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff tells it without naming a source, as one of many cases of strange craft showing up near nuclear weapons.
